_evidence.scripts/scripts.js decorateButtons: requires a.closest('strong')||a.closest('em'); p.className='button-wrapper'; a.className='button' + primary (strong) / secondary (em) / accent (strong+em)
_evidence.scripts/aem.js decorateBlock: adds .block + data-block-name, wraps in div.<name>-wrapper, section gains .<name>-container; wrapTextNodes runs before decorate()
_evidence.blocks/fragment/fragment.js loadFragment: main.innerHTML = fetch(path + '.plain.html'); scripts inert (innerHTML never executes; trusted-types default policy strips <script> on fragment sinks)
_evidence.sections: decorateSections sets data-section-status + inline display:none; the metadata block leaves an empty first section -> styles.css adds main .section:empty { display: none }
